description.zh:
RAM用户的控制台登录新密码。

密码必须符合密码强度要求。关于如何获取密码强度要求，请参见[GetPasswordPolicy](~~186691~~)。
description.en:
The new password that is used to log on to the console.

The password must meet the complexity requirements. For more information, see [GetPasswordPolicy](~~186691~~).

description.zh: RAM用户的控制台登录旧密码。
description.en: The old password that is used to log on to the console.

title.zh: RAM用户修改自己的登录密码

descriptions.zh: > 该API仅限RAM用户调用。调用前，请确保已将[SetSecurityPreference](~~43765~~)中的`AllowUserToChangePassword`设置为`True`，即允许RAM用户自主管理密码。
descriptions.en: > This operation is available only for RAM users. Before you call this operation, make sure that `AllowUserToChangePassword` in [SetSecurityPreference](~~43765~~) is set to `True`. The value True indicates that RAM users can manage their passwords.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims change-password --old-password mypassword --new-password newpassword --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ims ChangePassword --region cn-hangzhou --NewPassword newpassword --OldPassword mypassword
